# Dhermi Boat

Current website: https://dhermi.boats/

## Business

Dhermi Boat is a local Dhermi boat tour operator in Dhërmi, Albania. It offers small-group and private boat tours along the Albanian Riviera, including Gjipe, Grama Bay, Blue Cave, Karaburun, sunset private tours and morning fishing tours.

## Key Facts

- Departure area: Dhërmi, Albania.
- Shared Gjipe Tour: 1h30, 35 EUR adult, 20 EUR child.
- Shared Grama Bay Tour: 3h30, 75 EUR adult, 50 EUR child.
- Private Tour: 200 EUR per hour per group, minimum 2 hours.
- Small-group capacity: up to 15 guests depending on tour.
- Routes may change depending on wind, waves and sea conditions.

## Languages

The website includes a persistent EN / FR / AL language selector for the main conversion interface.
